verdict.rationale: The evidence only shows a Medusa docs MCP server for developers/IDEs (medusa-docs-4, medusa-probe-3) and Storefront API OpenAPI specs (medusa-gh-x1) for building custom storefronts — none of this constitutes a cross-merchant product catalog or feed designed for AI agents/answer engines to discover merchant products. No evidence of product feed standards, schema.org/agent-readable catalog exposure, or answer-engine indexing of merchant storefronts built on Medusa.
